_comment: Venues for the withdrawal-ability recorder (scripts/record-venue-liquidity.mjs). These are EXTERNAL mainnet venues (Ethereum), read via RECORDER_RPC_URL — NOT the local anvil. Entry shape: {name, kind, address, underlying?, decimals, enabled, notes}. Only enabled=true venues are recorded. Never guess an address; leave it empty and enabled=false until verified.

venues.name: sUSDe
venues.notes: Ethena Staked USDe (mainnet). underlying = USDe. Reads: cooldownDuration() uint24, totalAssets(), totalSupply(), silo() if present. cooling/stranded split is venue-specific and NOT fabricated here — raw params stored, instant_usd left null with a note.

venues.name: aave-v3-usde
venues.notes: needs verified aEthUSDe address — instant liquidity = underlying.balanceOf(aToken)
